title: Dutch residential battery market surges ahead of net metering phaseout
summary: With the abolition of net metering just weeks away, households are increasingly turning to battery storage to protect the value of their solar energy. New figures from Sunergy Research reveal explosive growth across all battery categories, with plug-in batteries emerging as the market's biggest breakthrough.
